meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你给的文字拆成12个思维维度逐项打分（1-10分），然后生成一份认知画像报告，包含主要思维模式、推理拓扑、决策特征等。报告会引用原文作为证据。
howto.when: 当你想分析某人如何思考、比较两个人的思维风格，或说“分析我的思维风格”“认知画像”等词时触发；提供文字并要求深入解读作者推理模式时也会触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维风格。
say.note: Claude 会输出12维度的认知画像报告。

say.text: 比较我和另外一个人的思考方式。
say.note: 需要提供两个人的文字，会生成对比分析。

say.text: 根据我们的对话，分析我的认知特征。
say.note: 会基于对话历史做自我画像并说明局限。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will score the supplied text across 12 cognitive dimensions (1-10), then produce a cognitive profile report covering dominant patterns, reasoning topology, and decision fingerprint, with quoted evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to analyze how someone thinks, compare thinking styles, or say phrases like "analyze my thinking style" or "cognitive profile"; also when you provide text and ask for deeper insight into the author's reasoning.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text's author.
say_en.note: Claude will output a 12-dimension cognitive profile.

say_en.text: Compare my thinking style with another person's.
say_en.note: Provide both texts for a comparison synthesis.

say_en.text: Profile my cognitive traits from our conversation.
say_en.note: Uses chat history, with caveats about AI-vs-human writing.
